# Final grade calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/grade-needed/

Calculate the final-exam percentage needed to achieve a target overall grade from your current coursework grade and the exam’s weight.

## How to use it

1. Choose a study tool and review its input labels.
2. Enter your scores, course details, passage or available study time.
3. Run the tool and review the result and its assumptions.

## Example

Find the final-exam score needed when coursework is 70%, the exam is worth 40%, and the overall target is 75%.

## Limits and checks

The current grade must describe the non-exam portion. Results above 100% indicate that the target is not reachable under these weights.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
